annotations.title: Google Ads shared negative keyword lists

description: Shared NEGATIVE KEYWORD LISTS: one list of blocked searches reused across Google Ads campaigns, or applied to the whole account. action: list (with sharedSetId shows its keywords) | create (name, keywords, campaignIds or accountLevel:true) | add (keywords) | remove_keywords (keywords or criterionIds) | attach / detach (campaignIds) | delete. keywords are "text" or {text, matchType: BROAD|PHRASE|EXACT}. Creating, adding and attaching only block ads, so they never need confirm. Removing keywords, detaching or deleting lets blocked searches show ads again: confirm:true on a live campaign, and always for delete. One ad group's own negatives: add_google_ads_keywords with negative:true.

accountLevel.description: create: apply to every campaign on the account

campaignIds.description: campaign ids to attach to or detach from the shared list

confirm.description: true only after the user approved a change to a LIVE campaign or a delete

customerId.description: omit to use the selected default account

keywords.description: keywords to block, as text strings or {text, matchType BROAD, PHRASE or EXACT} objects

loginCustomerId.description: manager id if operating through an MCC
